property_summary: For any uint256 delta, calling AdjustBetAmounts(delta) from the owner sets betLimit to exactly delta (i.e., replaces previous limit) — the mutant that increments instead will cause betLimit to differ from delta when the contract's prior betLimit was nonzero, which the fuzzer can expose by first setting a nonzero betLimit then calling AdjustBetAmounts with any delta.
change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the input amount (so AdjustBetAmounts increases limit instead of setting it).
